scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.clipper.config.ts && bun run scripts/check-worker.ts
scripts.build:dev: vite build --mode development && vite build -c vite.clipper.config.ts && bun run scripts/check-worker.ts
scripts.package: bun run build && cd dist && rm -f ../tiro-clipper.zip && zip -qr ../tiro-clipper.zip . -x '.DS_Store' '**/.DS_Store'
